scope: revision_chain reference SQL on the exported files without statistics, with the input `later` given as the recursive CTE, a one-step non-recursive CTE, or a temporary table holding the recursive result; outer joins unchanged; read-only on the files

design.perQueryTime: median of the timed passes; tableInput times the outer query only
design.percentile: linear interpolation between order statistics, position (n - 1) * q

queries.recursive: WITH RECURSIVE later(id) AS ( SELECT later FROM revision WHERE earlier = :anchor UNION SELECT v.later FROM revision v JOIN later l ON v.earlier = l.id) SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, p.pack_number FROM later JOIN document doc ON doc.id = later.id JOIN disposition d ON d.target = later.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = later.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
queries.oneStep: WITH later(id) AS (SELECT later FROM revision WHERE earlier = :anchor) SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, p.pack_number FROM later JOIN document doc ON doc.id = later.id JOIN disposition d ON d.target = later.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = later.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
queries.tableInput: SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, p.pack_number FROM later_input later JOIN document doc ON doc.id = later.id JOIN disposition d ON d.target = later.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = later.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id WHERE d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
queries.chainOnly: WITH RECURSIVE later(id) AS ( SELECT later FROM revision WHERE earlier = :anchor UNION SELECT v.later FROM revision v JOIN later l ON v.earlier = l.id) SELECT id FROM later
